title: The benefits of deploying IPv6 only
summary: A NANOG 64 panel with speakers from Comcast, APNIC, T-Mobile and Facebook on deploying IPv6-only networks, including performance data showing IPv6 outperforming NAT-ed IPv4.
why: Cited as real operator data that IPv6 is faster than IPv4 and that large networks are already going IPv6-only.

quote.text: Watch Paul Saab from Facebook talk about how much better IPv6 performs at NANOG 64
